content: I think we should discuss this on ACDC since clients have already made their assessments on this EIP at its current scope. So need to ask them how they feel about changing the scope. I know Prysm and Lighthouse have also expressed they prefer having the deposit guard only also

author: dgusakov
content: I think exiting will be a great signal to rotate since exited validators will no longer generate any rewards

author: fradamt
content: Hegota is not going to ship for a while, seems plenty of time for people to "get a signal". Anyway what's so bad about exiting them?

author: nflaig
content: what's the rationale for exiting them in hegota? once pq becomes relevant, there is a real security risk and we can argue why exiting is required. that's at least my rationale for delaying this until it's actually required

author: fradamt
content: If they are exited in Hegota, the vast majority of that stake will likely just migrate or withdraw and there will be a small remainder from lost keys, which we can just decide not to care about. If we don't take this step, we'll keep having the currently ~10k validators, which is quite a lot of ETH, and have to keep talking about what we would do come Q-day

author: fradamt
content: just seems like a problem we might as well get out of the way, what's the benefit from not?

author: kevaundray
content: whether we exit them or not, they will still be a problem come Q-day?

author: fradamt
content: what I am saying is, if Hegota exits them the vast majority of validators will just migrate (even before Hegota) or withdraw, they are not going to just leave the funds there, and then the problem is solved

author: fradamt
content: I would expect there would only be a handful of validators left, that have actually lost keys or are really checked out, like a few 100s

author: fradamt
content: at which point it's just not much of a problem

author: fradamt
content: whereas we could keep the status quo and then we have ~300k ETH that keeps sitting there, which is enough to worry about (depending on ETH price it could be billions)
